# 100.00 USD a customer owes, entered straight onto the receivable as an
# opening balance rather than through an invoice, so no invoice's lot holds it.
#
# The transaction is stated in CAD, so the USD has a cost of 1.35 and the split
# is a cost basis like any other.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank:USD
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Accounts Receivable USD
	type: Accounts Receivable
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Equity
	type: Equity
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Equity:Opening Balances
	type: Equity
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:FX Gain
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

2026-01-05 * "Opening balance: 100 USD a customer owes"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Accounts Receivable USD 100.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "1.35"
		value: "135.00"
	Equity:Opening Balances -135.00 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
		share_price: "1"
		value: "-135.00"
